"Crazy Cash" has 632,570 prizes of $1 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $100 prize, with 1,416 left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

The numbers for "Crazy Cash" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
1134.headline: Prize table details

1140.body:
"$25, $50 or $250" has 597,592 prizes of $25 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $50 prize, with 119,493 left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

The numbers for "$25, $50 or $250" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
1140.headline: A close look at the prizes

696.body:
"Monopoly 200X" has had no $5 million top prize claimed since we started watching it. Everyday prizes keep getting claimed, and fewer tickets are left each day. The number of tickets printed is fixed. Each day without a top prize claim leaves those prizes among fewer tickets.

Everything here about "Monopoly 200X" comes from official Ohio lottery numbers, current through November 21.
696.headline: No new top prize claims

762.body:
The most common win left on "Billion" is $100. The second biggest prize left is $1 million, and 40 of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

If "Billion" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
762.headline: What's actually left to win

827.body:
"50th Anniversary" is near the end of its run, with about a quarter of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, the top prizes are being claimed more slowly than the tickets are selling, which is a good sign.

Everything above about "50th Anniversary" comes from the Ohio Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
827.headline: Tickets sold so far

847.body:
The $500,000 top prize on "Bingo 50X" is no longer available because all four have been claimed. The biggest prize anyone can win today is $100,000. Use that amount when you decide.

Every line of Bingo 50X's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
847.headline: All four top prizes claimed

891.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "Cash Explosion 25X", only a small slice are still unsold. The game is near the end of its run, with two of ten top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

Tomorrow's count on "Cash Explosion 25X" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
891.headline: Early stage or late
